haystack.title: Research consultant
haystack.intro: Clients come with a question. My job is to get them a usable answer, from the first meeting to the final presentation. The method follows from the question.

steps.name: Methodology
steps.what: pick the design that answers it

steps.name: Screener & questionnaire
steps.what: the right people, the right questions

steps.name: Fieldwork
steps.what: follow up until the sample is in

steps.name: Insights
steps.what: what the client should decide, and why

haystack.panelText: In this team we make our internal processes more efficient and stay on top of new methods in research, such as predictive modelling and synthetic data. What I use myself: automatic dashboards in R and Displayr, and AI tools in my daily work.

jobs.title: CX data analyst
jobs.company: ING Belgium · assignment via Haystack Consulting
jobs.text: Part of the CoE CX & Innovation team. I analysed NPS data at bank, channel, product and journey level to feed into ING's customer experience strategy.

jobs.title: Student intern
